facts.fact: On 2 April 2025 the commune of Mongo, with the firm IT Solution Center, launched a ten-day taxpayer census of shops, bakeries and restaurants, described as the start of a digital tax system in which payments are to be recorded directly in the commune's management system; no other commune is named.
The census is run by the commune of Mongo in partnership with the firm IT Solution Center (ITSC), each enumerator accompanied by a collector and a municipal police officer.
The commune of Mongo launched a taxpayer census on 2 April 2025 to move local tax collection to a digital system.

systems.owner: Commune of Mongo with IT Solution Center
